description: Classroom-filtered French verb database. Excludes malformed, hyphenated, acronym-like and obvious technical/coinage entries.
translationNote: Meanings are retained from the supplied bilingual dictionary data. Known wrong/unsuitable entries are excluded; this package does not claim a human line-by-line semantic review of every retained sense.
all_verbs_selection: When All verbs is selected, the next question is always drawn from a different broad category than the previous question.
leaderboard_reset: Uses Firebase path leaderboard_v61_clean_start and independent local browser keys.
leaderboard_best_date: Displays the date a player's best streak was achieved.
reflexive_forms: Reflexive compound tenses are generated with être plus the correct reflexive pronoun, rather than using imported active forms.
reflexive_answer_variants: The app accepts appropriate feminine and plural past-participle agreement variants for reflexive compound tenses.
gender_agreement: Reflexive compound forms now use exact agreement when the displayed subject is il, elle, ils or elles.
reflexive_pronoun_repair: Stored reflexive pronouns are removed from imported simple-tense forms before the app adds the one correct pronoun for the displayed subject.
imperative_repair: Stored reflexive imperative endings such as -toi, -nous and -vous are not duplicated.
live_leaderboard_fix: Firebase realtime listener remains active; REST polling fallback refreshes every 3 seconds if Firebase SDK live connection is unavailable.
reflexive_compound_fix: All reflexive compound answers generated with être. Imported reflexive compound forms removed from JSON.
